questions.question: Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.Isis, Egyptian Aset or Eset, is one of the most important goddesses of ancient Egypt. Her name is the Greek form of an Egyptian word for “throne.” Though initially obscure, she rose in prominence and was later worshipped across the Roman Empire, from England to Afghanistan. She is still revered by some pagans today.Isis has been associated with being a magical healer because she cured the sick and brought the deceased to life. She was also a model mother and a key figure in funeral rites.According to myth, she was married to Osiris, king of Egypt. His jealous brother Seth trapped him in a wooden chest and threw it into the Nile. Isis found Osiris in Byblos and brought him back to Egypt. After Seth hacked Osiris into pieces, Isis, aided by her sister Nephthys, transformed into a bird, found all the parts, and magically reassembled him. Osiris lived on as a mummy.Isis is often depicted as a beautiful woman wearing a sheath dress and a throne-shaped crown or solar disk with cow’s horns. She is also represented as a bird, symbolizing her magical transformation during the search for Osiris.Isis, in Egyptian myth, has been associated with being ‘a magical healer’ because:
options: She brought her lost husband back to his kingdom Egypt.
She conspired with Seth to turn her husband into a mummy.
She was a beautiful woman and she loved her husband.
She could instill life into a dead person and heal an ailing person.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (She could instill life into a dead person and heal an ailing person.) है।
